remarks: The Potential and Possibilities are Endless with this extremely valuable property. Bordering the Rowayton line, this multi-family estate gives buyers a ton of possibility to renovate and generate income! Main House is set-up with a First Floor, 2-Bedroom Unit, which includes a full bath, eat-in kitchen, living room, wide-plank flooring under all rugs, and access to front porch and back porch. Second and Third Floor are set-up as a second unit with 2 bedrooms, full bath, eat-in kitchen and living room. Attic has potential to create a third bedroom. Back Cottage is a legal 2-bedroom with eat-in kitchen, living room, full bath and fenced-in side-yard space. 2-Car garage can be converted into additional living space*, or a workshop/office space. Ample parking in the expansive driveway in front of main house and back of house. This property sits on the Rowayton line and is convenient to I-95, Rowayton Train Station, South Norwalk Train Station and several Shops and Restaurants. Beautiful landscaping and mature trees add to the appeal and privacy of this diamond in the rough.
